text:
Maya Patel: Quick brain dump: propose a multiplexing 'bridge' to unify geo/cost/tenant routing heuristics. Goal: ship new heuristics without 1:1 adapters.

Jonas Reed: Sounds useful. Any perf model? my main worry is per-request overhead.

Maya Patel: Target shape:
```
bridge.Resolve(req) -> candidates[]
bridge.ReScore(candidates, context) -> ranked[]
bridge.Explain(candidates, detail_level) -> trace_str
```
Keep Resolve super cheap (fast filters). ReScore can be heavier off main path.

Priya S.: How do we handle tenant overrides + canaries? we need per-tenant policy injection and quick rollback.

Maya Patel: Options:
- policy plugins: WASM (sandbox + fast),
- remote policy RPC (safe, slower),
- env-level overrides in config (fastest)
We'd gate plugin usage with a feature flag per-tenant so rollout is incremental.

Lucien: WASM is attractive but watch cold-start. Also need deterministic memory accounting per-pod.

Jonas Reed: For storage lookups, can we batch Resolve calls? e.g., collect N requests(ms window) and do one fetch for capacity/zone info.

Maya Patel: Yes — planned batching and local region caches. Implementation notes:
- in-region in-memory candidate ring (lockless reads)
- capacity leases using CAS to avoid global locks
- short TTLs for region/cost snapshots (50-200ms)

ops-bot: perf-check: nightly-mux-bridge run completed. p50 unchanged, p95 +1.2% (investigate).

Priya S.: Telemetry: we can't emit full Explain traces for every request. Need sampling and a compact decision_event schema.

Maya Patel: Proposal: three explain levels: none/basic/sample. Basic emits chosen candidate id + top reason. Sample emits full trace but capped: 1/1000 requests by default, adjustable per-tenant.

Jonas Reed: Rollback strategy? we need a kill-switch that routes to legacy adapters instantly.

Maya Patel: Plan: control-plane flag + per-edge header override. If flag is off, edge proxies do `if header != mux && flag_off -> legacy`. Also a circuit-breaker that flips on error rates.

Priya S.: CI/perf gating constraints?

Maya Patel: Keep it tight:
- qps/regression: p95 increase <= 3% on synthetic workload
- memory: delta <= 120MB/node
- explain telemetry extra bytes <= 5% of baseline

Lucien: A note on scoring: don't bake raw cost into a single score. Keep cost/latency/region as separate dimensions so console can display tradeoffs. Score is a vector + final scalar for selection.

Maya Patel: Agree. We'll return both vector and scalar. UI folks can use vector for explain visuals.

qa-bot: test-suite: added integration scenario: cross-region failover + high-queue depth. Results pending.

Jonas Reed: Security: WASM plugin must run with strict capabilities and memory limits. Also audit logs for policy changes.

Maya Patel: Yep. KMS for policy signing, enable attestations, and record plugin version in decision_event.

Priya S.: Ops request: add tooling to replay decision_events against new policy builds so we can simulate regressions offline.

Maya Patel: Will add a 'replay' mode in the proto. Work items:
1) bridge proto (Resolve/ReScore/Explain) PR
2) WASM plugin POC (rust -> wasm) and sandbox runner
3) batching + local cache impl, lease via CAS
4) telemetry schema + sampling knobs
5) CI perf gates + rollback playbook
6) console explain integration (vector view)

Jonas Reed: ETA?

Maya Patel: Prototype in 3 weeks; initial canary to 5% tenants after perf gates in 6 weeks.

ops-bot: deploy: mux-bridge canary started at 2026-03-21T16:02Z -> 5% tenants.

Lucien: 👍 Add a short follow-up RFC doc with example policies (geo-preference, cost-slope, reserved-capacity bias).

Maya Patel: Will post RFC + sample configs tomorrow. Thanks all for quick feedback.
